theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_ll_gws_smooth_dense
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (c : Eucl n → Eucl n), IsOpen Ω → IntegrableOn c Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ b : Eucl n → Eucl n, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b ∧ HasCompactSupport b ∧ tsupport b ⊆ Ω ∧ ∫ w in Ω, ‖c w - b w‖ < δ
